session.name: order form fix
session.title: Fix the Northwind Bakery order form

blocks.text: The order form on the Northwind Bakery site drops the pickup date when a customer changes the quantity. Can you find out why and fix it?
The form probably rebuilds its state from the quantity handler and forgets the other fields. Read the component first.
I'll look at the order form component first.

todos.content: Find where the pickup date is lost
todos.activeForm: Finding where the pickup date is lost

blocks.text:
Found it. `onQuantity` replaces the whole order object, so **every other field is dropped**:

```js
const onQuantity = q => setOrder({ quantity: q });
```

I'll keep the rest of the order when the quantity changes.

input.old_string: const onQuantity = q => setOrder({ quantity: q });
input.new_string: const onQuantity = q => setOrder(o => ({ ...o, quantity: q }));

blocks.output:
> northwind-bakery@1.4.0 test
> node --test src/order

# tests 14

# fail 0
# duration_ms 812
An updater function takes the pending state and returns the next state.

blocks.text:
Fixed. The quantity handler now keeps the pickup date and every other field, and the 14 order tests pass.

- `src/order/OrderForm.js`: `onQuantity` uses an updater
- no other file needed a change
